mechanism.claim: A completed daily VVIX change that is large relative to its causal rolling beta on the same-session VIX change identifies an orthogonal convexity-demand surprise. Positive residual convexity pressure transmits risk-off to BTC, while negative residual pressure transmits relief, for twelve hours after the next Cboe open.
mechanism.side: negative sign of the standardized VVIX-on-VIX change residual
mechanism.why_distinct: CCBRR removes the causal VIX beta from VVIX changes. Convexity acceleration candidates used the fixed log(VVIX/VIX) difference and BTC/crypto-vol confirmation; VSDAR used sign disagreement with VIX; no prior candidate used a rolling pre-entry OLS residual.
mechanism.why_suited_to_volatile_regimes: the feature isolates volatility-of-volatility demand unexplained by the contemporaneous VIX shock
mechanism.why_low_gross9_overlap_is_plausible: official next-session Cboe timing and a daily external residual are absent from Gross9

features.rolling_fit: OLS y=a+b*x on at most 252 immediately prior finite common changes, minimum 126; current excluded

clock.trigger: every eligible completed Cboe observation; no onset filter
clock.entry: first later exact common Cboe source date at 09:35 America/New_York
clock.reservation: global half-open, entry equal prior exit accepted

economic_gates.accounting: fixed quantity, exact funding marks, 6bp base and 10bp stress per notional side, every held 5m favorable then adverse, global HWM, full-calendar CAGR

research_boundary.selection_basis: independent causal beta-residual feature frozen before incidence

stopping_rule: Terminal first-failure sequence: source support, Gross9 novelty, strict economics; no threshold, side, hold, clock, or subset repair.
